answer_2.quote: Regarding our proposed Inter-GPS model, if the one closest to the found solution among the four choices is exactly the ground truth, the found solution is considered correct.

answer_4.quote: We push the test-split data of the dataset in the crowd-sourcing platform, Amazon Mechanical Turk. Each eligible annotator must have obtained a high school or higher degree and is asked to answer 10 problems in 25 minutes.
answer_4.guideline: Each eligible annotator must have obtained a high school or higher degree and is asked to answer 10 problems in 25 minutes. To ensure annotators solving the problem to the best of their ability, they are further asked to spend at least 7 minutes on the problem set and 10 seconds on each problem.
